title: Wii Sports Theme
blurb: That jaunty piano tune opened millions of family evenings in 2007, and it functions now as pure distilled nostalgia. Wii Sports came in the box, which meant it reached people who had never played a video game in their lives — hence the specific memories it summons: wrist straps ignored, a television screen struck by a flying remote, a grandmother discovering an unexpected talent for bowling and refusing to be humble about it. It is beloved for reasons that have little to do with the game and everything to do with who was in the room.
origin: The main theme from Wii Sports (Nintendo, 2006).
